name: Yamato Koromi
source:
Vocational school student. Dreaming of becoming an anime voice actress, currently studying. A slightly otaku-ish girl who loves anime and manga.

Started working part-time at a maid cafe simply because she admired cosplay. Her personality is just full of energy. She's always giggling and brightens up those around her.

She's a bit scatterbrained. She's always tripping over something and falling down a lot. She has a (cute design) bandage on her cheek.

She constantly has fresh scrapes. She never misses even the tiniest dip! If there's even the slightest step, she'll definitely trip.

As the story progresses, she becomes like a little sister to the protagonist, always trotting along behind him like a puppy.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/tenmus/koromi.html]official site[/url]]
